This mismatch allowed disallowed linker flags or unvalidated linker search paths to be smuggled past the go command's flag checks and passed to the external linker. In addition, deduplicating LDFLAGS in the go command could panic with an out-of-bounds slice index when a prefix of the flag list matched near the end of the slice. "cmd/compile" and "cmd/go" now properly handle backslash-escaped quotes and unquote "//go:cgo_*" pragma strings with strconv.Unquote, and the slice bounds check in processCgoOutputs has been fixed.

FreeScout is a self-hosted help desk and shared mailbox. Prior to 1.8.230, multiple outbound paths in Helper::downloadRemoteFile(), Helper::checkPort(), Helper::sanitizeRemoteUrl(), MailboxesController.php, and ModulesController.php do not consistently enforce a sink-level restricted-host policy. An authenticated administrator, or another authenticated user permitted to change mailbox connection settings or trigger module update or installation paths, can supply attacker-controlled URLs or hosts. The independent download and port-test sinks can reach encoded or otherwise uncovered loopback and internal addresses. The redirect-validation bypass additionally requires a configured whitelist that permits the original and final hosts while a restricted internal host appears only as an intermediate redirect hop. No unauthenticated SSRF path is established. The server can consequently contact loopback and internal services, provide a blind internal port oracle, and retrieve internal HTTP responses into application-controlled download sinks. This issue is fixed in version 1.8.230.

FreeScout is a self-hosted help desk and shared mailbox. Prior to 1.8.225, the administrative tools.php maintenance endpoint is reachable without an appropriate authentication or access-control boundary. Response differences for attacker-controlled path values disclose whether arbitrary directories and files exist on the server. The same endpoint validates application-key and database-password candidates without rate limiting, per-session throttling, or a CAPTCHA, allowing unrestricted guessing attempts against application secrets. This issue is fixed in version 1.8.225.

FreeScout is a self-hosted help desk and shared mailbox. Prior to 1.8.225, a user who can edit a mailbox signature can combine a scriptable file uploaded through /uploads/upload with nested tag fragments that bypass Helper::stripDangerousTags(). The resulting external script is served from the same origin, so the script-src 'self' policy permits it when another user opens the affected mailbox reply editor or new-ticket page. The script executes with the victim's FreeScout privileges and can read visible data and perform same-origin actions. This issue is fixed in version 1.8.225.

The Symfony Serializer component DataUriNormalizer handles only the exact types SplFileInfo, SplFileObject, and File, so for a property typed with a subclass such as UploadedFile, ObjectNormalizer instantiates the object through its constructor from attacker-controlled data, including the file path. This allows an arbitrary file on the server to be treated as an uploaded file in Symfony versions prior to 5.4.56, 6.x prior to 6.4.50, 7.x prior to 7.4.23, and 8.x prior to 8.1.11.

A request body such as {"image": {"path": "/path/to/project/.env.local", "originalName": "a.png", "test": true}} makes the application handle any file on the server as an upload, without the file being sent. With test: true, UploadedFile::isValid() skips is_uploaded_file() and move() falls back to rename(). Assert\File does not prevent this because it validates the file at the attacker-chosen path, which exists on the server.
Any code that deserializes untrusted data into a type that holds such a property is affected. That includes #[MapRequestPayload] on a DTO with an UploadedFile property, which is how uploads are mapped in Symfony 8.1; a single unauthenticated request with a JSON or form body is enough. Depending on what the application does with the upload, this can expose any file readable by PHP (for instance, when uploads are stored and served back), move any such file when move() is called, and reveal whether a path exists.

A serializer built without DataUriNormalizer ahead of the object normalizer is not protected by the fix; the serializer configured by FrameworkBundle is.

A vulnerability has been found in xxyopen/201206030 novel up to 3.5.0. This impacts the function BookServiceImpl.getBookContentAbout of the file src/main/java/io/github/xxyopen/novel/service/impl/BookServiceImpl.java of the component Book Content Service. Such manipulation of the argument chapterId leads to improper authorization. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The name of the patch is 966c4bdde3521dc0a165d15a2acff66ee33eaaa7. Applying a patch is advised to resolve this issue.

Grida through 0.0.24 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the Forms file-preview API routes that allows unauthenticated attackers to read other organizations' form response files. Attackers can use form and field IDs exposed in public form payloads with a chosen path parameter to obtain service-role signed URLs for attachments and connected Supabase bucket objects.

Fluxbox through 1.3.7 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in RootTheme::reconfigTheme() that allows attackers to execute commands via crafted style background values. Attackers can embed shell metacharacters in background pixmap paths, random directories, or gradient texture text, which are concatenated unescaped into an fbsetbg command run via $SHELL -c when the style loads.

Usermin through 2.570 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in mailbox/detach.cgi that allows remote attackers to execute script by supplying an arbitrary type parameter that bypasses JavaScript filtering. Attackers can email an HTML attachment containing script and lure recipients to a detach.cgi link with type=text/html to run script in the victim's authenticated Usermin session.

ABP Framework before 10.7.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that skips account state and two-factor checks when password login succeeds through a registered IExternalLoginProvider. Attackers holding the external directory password for deactivated, locked, or 2FA-protected accounts can obtain valid access tokens from the /connect/token password grant.

Craft CMS from 5.8.17 before 5.11.2 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability because getOwners() applies caller criteria without cleansing the query configuration. Authenticated control panel users can invoke attacker-selected static PHP callables via crafted criteria to promote every account to administrator.

WWBN AVideo 29.0 through 29.4.0 contains a race condition vulnerability in plugin/PayPalYPT/ipn.php that allows attackers to bypass IPN replay protection due to a non-atomic deduplication check and insert. Attackers can concurrently replay a captured valid recurring-payment notification so both requests pass isRecurringPaymentIdUsed(), obtaining duplicate wallet credits and subscription renewals.

Wazuh from 3.9.0 before 4.14.9 contains a missing TLS hostname verification vulnerability in the fluent-forward module's wm_fluent_ssl_ctx() that allows network attackers to impersonate the Fluentd collector by presenting any certificate chaining to the configured ca_file. Attackers who redirect the connection via DNS, ARP, or on-path positions can receive forwarded security telemetry and the shared_key_hexdigest for offline cracking.

Wazuh agent from 1.0.0 before 4.14.9 contains a stack-based buffer overflow in the logcollector snort-full log reader that miscalculates remaining buffer space in read_snortfull(). Attackers who write crafted multi-line content to a monitored snort-full log can overflow the 65,280-byte stack buffer, crashing the agent or overwriting an SEH handler on 32-bit Windows agents running as SYSTEM.

Insertion of sensitive information into log file vulnerability in Johnson Controls C-CURE 9000, Victor allows Use of Known Operating System Credentials.

This issue affects C-CURE 9000, Victor: 3.20.

Inclusion of functionality from untrusted control sphere vulnerability in Johnson Controls EasyIO Neo IOManager and Tools Installer allows Malicious Software Update.

This issue affects EasyIO Neo IOManager and Tools Installer: 1.1.0.0.
vp: easyio neo iomanager and tools installer

cves.d: LimeSurvey Community Edition 7.8.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in the survey-archive participant import and SPSS-response export workflow. An authenticated user with global surveys.create permission can import a crafted .lsa archive whose participant XML creates an attacker-named attribute column. When the user exports responses from the imported non-anonymous survey, LimeSurvey passes the persisted name to Yii's select builder. Names containing parentheses are treated as SQL expressions instead of quoted identifiers, causing attacker-controlled SQL to execute with the application's database privileges.

node-fontnik is a library that delivers a range of glyphs rendered as SDFs (signed distance fields) in a protocol buffer. Prior to version 0.7.7, a crafted font could trigger a heap out-of-bounds write in RenderSDF (include/mapbox/glyph_foundry_impl.hpp). RenderSDF computed the SDF bitmap allocation size as buffered_width * buffered_height in 32-bit unsigned int. Glyph dimensions are derived from the uploaded font's outline bounding box with no upper bound, so a glyph large enough to make that product exceed 2³² wrapped to a small value. The buffer was then under-allocated while the render loop still wrote one byte per pixel, corrupting the heap (CWE-190 → CWE-787) and crashing the process. A 680-byte font is enough to drive FreeType to a 65536×65536 buffered glyph, wrapping the size to 0. This issue has been patched in version 0.7.7.

Padloc before 4.3.1 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in ScimServer._handleScimGet() that allows unauthenticated attackers to read SCIM directories by sending any non-empty bearer token. Attackers who know an organization id can query the Users and Groups SCIM endpoints to retrieve provisioned usernames, emails, names, externalIds, and group memberships.

FFmpeg 0.10 through 9.0.2 contains an uninitialized memory disclosure vulnerability in sunrast_decode_frame() in libavcodec/sunrast.c that leaves decoded image regions unwritten for truncated input. Attackers can supply a crafted truncated Sun Raster image, RLE-encoded or raw, to leak stale heap contents such as allocator metadata through the decoded picture.

FFmpeg 2.1 through 9.0.2 contains an uninitialized memory disclosure vulnerability in pcx_decode_frame() in libavcodec/pcx.c that leaves scanline buffer bytes uncleared when input ends early. Attackers can supply a crafted truncated RLE-compressed or uncompressed PCX image to leak heap memory contents through the decoded pixels.

Padloc 4.0.0 before 4.3.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the legacy retrieveMFAToken handler that never counts wrong email verification codes toward the attempt limit. Unauthenticated attackers knowing a victim's email can brute force the 6-digit code to obtain verification tokens usable in signup, login and account recovery flows.

Padloc 4.0.0 before 4.3.1 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability that allows SCIM token holders to modify Object.prototype by sending crafted SCIM PATCH paths to ScimServer._handleScimUsersPatch(). Attackers can supply paths like __proto__.x or constructor.prototype.x passed to setPath() to pollute the shared server process, disrupting requests for all other organizations.

Mbin 1.2.1 before 1.11.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in EmbedElement::buildDestructed() that renders nested Markdown image alt text and URL without HTML escaping. Authenticated users can embed HTML in the alt text of an image inside a link in entries, comments, posts, messages, or bios to run script in viewers' browsers.

Semantic MediaWiki 3.0.0 before 7.4.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Special:Ask with the ElasticStore backend, allowing users with edit rights to inject script through unescaped native_result and score_set output. Attackers can store markup in a Text property or subobject name, then lure victims including administrators to a crafted Special:Ask link to execute script in their session.

Semantic MediaWiki 7.3.1 before 7.4.1 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in EditProtectionUpdater::userMayChangeProtection() that checks protection changes against the page's latest revision author. Editors can add {{#set:Is edit protected=false}} to a transcluded template, removing administrator edit and move protection logged under the administrator's name.

Semantic MediaWiki 3.0.0 before 7.4.1 contains a denial of service vulnerability in the ElasticStore and SPARQLStore ConceptDescriptionInterpreter classes, which re-expand concepts without memoization or an expansion budget. Users with page-edit rights can build acyclic chains of Concept: pages that fan out, so queries via concept page views, Special:Ask, or api.php action=ask exhaust CPU and memory.

Semantic MediaWiki 2.5.0 before 7.4.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in ValueFormatter::getFormattedSubject() that renders property label segments after a literal   as unescaped markup. Users with page-edit rights can set a preferred property label containing an img onerror payload that executes when anyone, including administrators, views Special:Browse or the smwbrowse API.

Semantic MediaWiki 2.4.0 before 7.4.1 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in TimeValueFormatter::getCaptionFromFreeFormat(), which emits free-format date captions in HTML without escaping. Unauthenticated attackers can craft a Special:Ask URL with HTML markup in a date printout format (#-F[...]) to execute script in a logged-in victim's browser session.

Semantic MediaWiki 3.0.0 before 7.4.1 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in the ElasticStore ConceptDescriptionInterpreter that only detects directly self-referencing concepts. Users with page-edit rights can create mutually referencing concept pages, causing concept page views, Special:Ask, or api.php action=ask queries to exhaust PHP memory or stack.

Semantic MediaWiki 2.5.0 before 7.4.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows editors without the edit-protection right to lock pages by adding an Is edit protected annotation. Attackers can add [[Is edit protected::true]] to pages or #set it in widely transcluded templates, so the TitleQuickPermissions hook blocks other editors and administrators from editing, moving or deleting them indefinitely.

Semantic MediaWiki 3.0.0 before 7.4.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the DataTables integration that initialises author-written smw-datatable tables unchanged. Users with page-edit rights can add HTML entity-encoded markup in data-search or data-filter cell attributes, executing script in viewers' browsers including administrators.

Semantic MediaWiki 4.2.0 before 7.4.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in OptionsBuilder::profiles() that allows users with the smw-schemaedit right to inject markup. Attackers can save FACETEDSEARCH_PROFILE_SCHEMA profile keys or labels that break out of option elements, executing scripts for every Special:FacetedSearch visitor including administrators.

OpenMRS module bahmnicore contains Core OpenMRS modules for Bahmni (including ERP & ELIS Atom Feed Clients). In version 0.93, there is insufficient validation of input paths during the admin CSV import process, allowing for potential arbitrary file write. This issue has been patched in version 0.93.1.

OpenMRS module bahmnicore contains Core OpenMRS modules for Bahmni (including ERP & ELIS Atom Feed Clients). In version 0.93, an attacker with authenticated access could potentially exfiltrate sensitive data from the database. This issue has been patched in version 0.93.1.
Authorization bypass through user-controlled key in Entra Device Registration allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.

Viber for iOS through 29.4.0.24 fails to validate the logical screen width and height in received GIF headers, allowing attackers to crash the app. Attackers can send a crafted GIF with zero dimensions that triggers an uncaught NSInternalInconsistencyException, aborting the app with SIGABRT when opened.

WWBN AVideo through 29.7.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in API::get_api_tags() in plugin/API/API.php that allows registered users to access restricted video data by querying the tags API. Attackers can subscribe to a tag and query APIName=tags to obtain filenames, titles and stored video_password values of unlisted, group-restricted and password-protected videos, enabling unauthorized viewing.

WWBN AVideo 6.5 through 29.7.1 contains an email verification bypass vulnerability in User::verifyCode() in objects/user.php caused by PHP loose comparison of the recoverPass token. Registered users can reuse the installation-wide salt from their own verification link and craft a code with arbitrary users_id and recoverPass set to true to verify other accounts' emails, unlocking features such as live streaming.

WWBN AVideo through 29.7.1 contains an improper payment verification vulnerability in plugin/PayPalYPT/ipnV2.php that credits wallets from PayPal IPNs not bound to the site's merchant account. Unauthenticated attackers can forward genuine VERIFIED recurring-payment IPNs from their own PayPal account with a chosen users_id to add wallet balance each billing cycle.

WWBN AVideo 6.5 through 29.7.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to log in as any user via Hybridauth social login display names. Attackers can set their X, Facebook, Yahoo or LinkedIn display name to a victim's username and withhold email, causing login.json.php or oauth2.php to log them in as that account, including administrators, without a password.

WWBN AVideo through 29.7.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in Live plugin restream endpoints that allows authenticated streamers to obtain other users' stream keys by supplying arbitrary live_transmitions_history_id values. Attackers can redeem the issued action tokens at verifyTokenForAction.json.php to retrieve victims' HLS URLs and stream keys, then publish as the victim or restream private or pay-per-view lives.

Directus before 12.1.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to skip permission checks by sending a failed auth message on public-mode WebSocket connections. Attackers can send an invalid token so handleAuthRequest sets accountability to null, then read, create, update or delete records in any user-defined collection.

Jellyfin before 12.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the DELETE /Library/VirtualFolders and POST /Library/VirtualFolders/Name endpoints that allows attackers to delete or move directories via unvalidated library names. Unauthenticated attackers can supply names like .. or absolute paths before setup completes to recursively delete the data directory and jellyfin.db.

WriteFreely before 0.17.3 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated authors to inject HTML by supplying a malicious post slug via the CreatePost API. The raw slug is concatenated into an anchor by augmentReadingDestination() for paid-shortcode posts, executing script for RSS/Atom feed readers, newsletter recipients and ActivityPub viewers.

LibreCAD through 2.2.1.6 contains a heap-based out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the bundled libdxfrw dwgReader18::parseDataPage() function due to unchecked buffer size and page offsets. Attackers can craft an AC1018 (R2004) DWG file with malicious startOffset values that cause decompress18 to write past the heap buffer when opened, causing crashes and potential code execution.

1Panel-dev CordysCRM before 1.9.6 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in CustomerContactController.get that allows authenticated users to read other users' contacts because no organization, owner or data-scope check is applied. Attackers holding ordinary contact or customer read permission can request GET /account/contact/get/{id} with another contact's ID to obtain names, phone numbers, owners, departments, linked customers and custom fields.

MQTTX desktop through 1.13.3 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to inject script by publishing malicious MQTT topic names or payloads rendered unescaped in tooltips. Attackers controlling a broker or publishing to subscribed topics can execute script in the Electron renderer, which has nodeIntegration enabled, when victims hover Topic Tree or JSON tree nodes.

In Retry_MtsMessageInPending of MtsMessageController.cpp, there is a possible way to trigger memory exhaustion via leaked message objects due to a logic error. This could lead to remote denial of service with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

In StartTimer of UcePublishManager.cpp, there is a possible way to trigger a process abort during timer calculation due to an integer overflow. This could lead to remote denial of service with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

In DecodeHeaderComponent of SipStack.cpp, there is a possible way to trigger stack exhaustion via unbounded mutual recursion due to a resource exhaustion. This could lead to remote denial of service with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

In RespondReceivedMessage of MtsMessageController.cpp, there is a possible way to trigger a double free and process abort during message retry handling due to a use after free. This could lead to remote denial of service with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

In multiple locations, there is a possible way to trigger a temporary denial of service via an integer overflow trap due to improper input validation. This could lead to remote denial of service with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

In multiple locations, there is a possible way to trigger an out of bounds read and temporary denial of service due to improper input validation. This could lead to remote denial of service with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

http.cookiejar.CookieJar deleted a stored cookie when a response carried an
already expired Set-Cookie header for it, using the Domain and Path
attributes from the header without consulting the cookie policy. A server
could therefore delete cookies belonging to other domains from a shared
cookie jar, such as the one used by urllib's HTTPCookieProcessor. The fix
consults the cookie policy before an expired cookie may delete an existing
one, as required by RFC 6265 section 5.3.

In CompareTelUris of SipAddress.cpp, there is a possible way to trigger an unhandled out of range exception and process crash due to an incorrect bounds check. This could lead to remote denial of service with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.
When ca_certs parameter was supplied to ssl.get_server_certificate() function, the identity of the certificate is not checked.

ai.summary_en: Today's vulnerability landscape is characterized by a high volume of critical remote code execution and privilege escalation flaws targeting foundational enterprise and operational technology environments. Microsoft ecosystems face pervasive risks, including unauthenticated RCE in Windows SMB and Print Spooler, extensive SQL Server heap overflows allowing database takeover, and systemic authorization failures within SharePoint and Office applications. Network infrastructure is heavily impacted by multiple authentication bypasses and command injections in Fortinet devices, while cloud and development sectors report dangerous authorization gaps in Azure services and remote code execution vulnerabilities in Visual Studio Code that threaten CI/CD pipelines and developer workstations.
ai.summary_zh: 当前漏洞态势以大量针对基础企业环境与运营技术(OT)环境的关键远程代码执行(RCE)及提权漏洞为特征。微软生态系统面临广泛风险，涵盖Windows SMB与Print Spooler中的未认证RCE、可致数据库被接管的SQL Server大规模堆溢出漏洞，以及SharePoint和Office应用中的系统性授权失效。网络基础设施受Fortinet设备中多重身份验证绕过与命令注入的严重影响；云与开发领域则报告了Azure服务中存在的危险授权缺陷，以及Visual Studio Code中的远程代码执行漏洞，均对CI/CD流水线及开发人员工作站构成威胁。

items.reason_en: A use-after-free flaw in the Wayland compositor allows local attackers to trigger crashes or potential code execution during asynchronous image processing.
items.reason_zh: Wayland 合成器中的释放后使用漏洞允许本地攻击者在异步图像处理过程中触发崩溃或潜在代码执行。

items.reason_en: Vim netrw plugin flaw enables arbitrary script and shell command execution via crafted filenames containing quote characters.
items.reason_zh: Vim netrw 插件漏洞允许攻击者通过包含引号的构造文件名执行任意脚本和 Shell 命令。

items.reason_en: Dell Display Manager TOCTOU vulnerability allows low-privilege local users to escalate privileges and achieve code execution.
items.reason_zh: Dell Display Manager 中的 TOCTOU 漏洞允许低权限本地用户提权并实现代码执行。

items.reason_en: Heap buffer overflow in the gvfs SFTP backend allows malicious servers to trigger out-of-bounds reads, potentially crashing desktop applications or leaking sensitive memory.
items.reason_zh: gvfs SFTP 后端的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞允许恶意服务器触发越界读取，可能导致桌面应用崩溃或敏感内存泄露。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in GIMP's PVR plug-in enables heap-based buffer overflows when processing crafted image files, posing a direct risk for local code execution.
items.reason_zh: GIMP 的 PVR 插件存在整数溢出漏洞，在处理构造的图像文件时会引发基于堆的缓冲区溢出，直接导致本地代码执行风险。

items.reason_en: Webmin's certificate issuance CGI fails to sanitize user-supplied DN fields, allowing authenticated administrators to inject arbitrary lines into system configuration files.
items.reason_zh: Webmin 证书颁发 CGI 模块未对用户提供的 DN 字段进行过滤，允许已认证管理员向系统配置文件中注入任意内容。

items.reason_en: Critical authorization flaw in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables network-based privilege escalation, directly compromising enterprise desktop environments.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中存在关键授权漏洞，可导致基于网络的提权，直接威胁企业桌面环境安全。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows TPM allows local privilege escalation, undermining hardware-rooted security mechanisms on client devices.
items.reason_zh: Windows TPM 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许本地提权，破坏了客户端设备上的硬件信任根安全机制。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in Windows LDAP poses a critical remote code execution risk targeting Active Directory environments, which are foundational to enterprise identity management.
items.reason_zh: Windows LDAP 中的越界写入漏洞针对 Active Directory 环境构成严重的远程代码执行风险，而 AD 是企业身份管理的基础架构。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows SMB enables unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code over the network, continuing the historical exploitation pattern of SMB services.
items.reason_zh: Windows SMB 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未经认证的远程攻击者通过网络执行任意代码，延续了 SMB 服务长期存在的利用模式。

items.reason_en: Print Spooler heap overflow allows unauthenticated remote code execution, maintaining the print service as a high-value target for lateral movement and privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: Print Spooler 堆溢出漏洞允许未经认证的远程代码执行，使打印服务持续成为横向移动与提权的高价值攻击目标。

items.reason_en: Critical out-of-bounds write in the Windows Search component enables remote code execution without authentication, posing a severe threat to endpoint integrity.
items.reason_zh: Windows Search 组件中存在关键越界写入漏洞，可在无需认证的情况下实现远程代码执行，对终端完整性构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: An untrusted search path vulnerability in the Remote Desktop Client allows network-based privilege escalation by manipulating DLL loading sequences.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client 中的非受信任搜索路径漏洞允许攻击者通过操纵 DLL 加载顺序实现基于网络的提权。

items.reason_en: A heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office Excel permits remote code execution through crafted documents, directly impacting end-user systems.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Excel 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过构造文档实现远程代码执行，直接威胁终端用户系统。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office Word enables remote code execution via crafted documents, posing a critical threat to end-user workstations.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Word 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过构造文档实现远程代码执行，对终端用户工作站构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free flaw in PowerPoint allows unauthorized network-based code execution, frequently leveraged in targeted phishing campaigns.
items.reason_zh: PowerPoint 中的释放后使用漏洞允许未经授权的基于网络的代码执行，常被定向网络钓鱼攻击所利用。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in the Windows Program Compatibility Assistant Service facilitates local privilege escalation, potentially compromising system integrity.
items.reason_zh: Windows Program Compatibility Assistant Service 中的堆溢出漏洞可辅助本地提权，进而可能破坏系统完整性。

items.reason_en: Cryptographic signature verification bypass in Windows RPC runtime permits remote code execution across trusted internal networks.
items.reason_zh: Windows RPC 运行库中的密码学签名验证绕过漏洞允许攻击者在可信的内部网络中执行远程代码。

items.reason_en: Critical authentication bypass in Kerberos enables unauthorized network access and potential domain compromise without valid credentials.
items.reason_zh: Kerberos 协议中存在关键认证绕过漏洞，可在无有效凭据的情况下实现未授权的网络访问及潜在的域渗透。

items.reason_en: Flawed authorization checks in Active Directory Domain Services allow attackers to execute arbitrary code remotely, risking widespread lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Domain Services 中的授权检查缺陷允许攻击者远程执行任意代码，极易引发大规模的横向移动。

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in NTFS permits remote code execution via specially crafted file system requests, bypassing standard isolation mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: NTFS 中的非受信任指针解引用漏洞允许通过特制的文件系统请求实现远程代码执行，从而绕过标准隔离机制。

items.reason_en: Inclusion of untrusted functionality in the Advanced Rasterization Platform facilitates local privilege escalation through the Windows graphics subsystem.
items.reason_zh: Advanced Rasterization Platform 中集成了非受信任功能，可通过 Windows 图形子系统辅助本地提权。

items.reason_en: Improper input sanitization in the Windows Installer leads to insecure library loading, allowing locally authenticated users to gain elevated system privileges.
items.reason_zh: Windows Installer 中的输入过滤不当会导致不安全的动态库加载，允许本地已认证用户获取高权限系统访问权。

items.reason_en: SMB remains a primary attack vector for lateral movement; this race condition in the transport driver enables remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: SMB 仍是横向移动的主要攻击面；该传输驱动程序的竞争条件漏洞可实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Print services are frequently targeted for initial access; path traversal here allows remote attackers to escalate privileges over the network.
items.reason_zh: 打印服务常作为初始入侵的目标；此处存在的路径穿越漏洞允许远程攻击者通过网络实现提权。

items.reason_en: Compromises network configuration integrity by allowing adjacent attackers to execute code via the DHCP client service heap overflow.
items.reason_zh: 该漏洞允许同网段攻击者利用 DHCP 客户端服务的堆溢出执行代码，从而破坏网络配置完整性。

items.reason_en: Extremely high severity across gaming and workstation networks, enabling unrestricted remote code execution through the Xbox Live networking stack.
items.reason_zh: 该漏洞在游戏与工作站内网中危害极高，允许攻击者通过 Xbox Live 网络栈实施无限制的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Widely deployed target for phishing campaigns, allowing attackers to execute arbitrary code locally upon opening malicious documents.
items.reason_zh: 该目标是网络钓鱼攻击的常见载体，攻击者可诱骗用户在打开恶意文档时在本地执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated network RCE in Media Foundation allows attackers to execute arbitrary code remotely by processing malicious media streams without user interaction.
items.reason_zh: Media Foundation 中存在无需认证的远程代码执行（RCE）漏洞，攻击者可通过处理恶意媒体流在无需用户交互的情况下远程执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated network RCE via Color Management enables remote code execution across Windows endpoints, posing a severe threat to desktop security postures.
items.reason_zh: 颜色管理模块中存在无需认证的远程代码执行（RCE）漏洞，可跨 Windows 终端实现远程代码执行，对桌面安全态势构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated network RCE in Virtual Filtering Platform allows attackers to execute code remotely through manipulated network traffic targeting filtering drivers.
items.reason_zh: Virtual Filtering Platform 中的无需身份验证的网络远程代码执行漏洞允许攻击者通过针对过滤驱动程序的篡改网络流量远程执行代码。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated network RCE in iSCSI service compromises storage networking infrastructure and grants full system control to remote attackers.
items.reason_zh: iSCSI 服务中的无需身份验证的网络远程代码执行漏洞会破坏存储网络基础设施，并使远程攻击者获得完全的系统控制权。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated network RCE in Windows Media Player highlights critical risks from crafted media files delivered over network boundaries.
items.reason_zh: Windows Media Player 中的无需身份验证的网络远程代码执行漏洞凸显了通过网络边界交付的构造媒体文件所带来的关键风险。

items.reason_en: Local privilege escalation in LSASS directly threatens credential harvesting and domain compromise once initial authenticated access is achieved on an endpoint.
items.reason_zh: LSASS 中的本地权限提升漏洞一旦在终端上获得初始认证访问权限，将直接威胁凭据收集与域渗透。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in LSASS allows local privilege escalation, potentially exposing cached credentials and domain secrets.
items.reason_zh: LSASS 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致本地权限提升，可能泄露缓存凭据和域密钥。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Color Management enables remote code execution via crafted media files, widely exploitable across user workstations.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Color Management 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可通过构造的媒体文件实现远程代码执行，在用户工作站中可被广泛利用。

items.reason_en: Double free in Microsoft DirectMusic allows remote code execution, impacting systems relying on legacy audio processing components.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft DirectMusic 中的双重释放漏洞可导致远程代码执行，影响依赖传统音频处理组件的系统。

items.reason_en: Command injection in Windows Task Scheduler enables local privilege escalation by manipulating scheduled task parameters.
items.reason_zh: Windows Task Scheduler 中的命令注入漏洞通过操纵计划任务参数实现本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in Windows Kernel allows local privilege escalation, undermining core OS security boundaries.
items.reason_zh: Windows Kernel 中的越界写入漏洞可导致本地权限提升，破坏核心操作系统的安全边界。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited supply chain compromise in DAEMON Tools Lite allowing remote code execution. Its inclusion in CISA KEV highlights an immediate, real-world threat to end-user systems.
items.reason_zh: DAEMON Tools Lite 中存在正在被主动利用的供应链漏洞，允许远程代码执行。其被列入 CISA KEV 清单凸显了对终端用户系统的即时现实威胁。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows Raw Image Extension enables unauthenticated remote code execution via malicious images. This affects a widely used system component across modern Windows versions.
items.reason_zh: Windows Raw Image Extension 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可通过恶意图像实现无需身份验证的远程代码执行。该漏洞影响了现代 Windows 版本中广泛使用的系统组件。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in the Local Security Authority Subsystem Service (LSASS) allows local privilege escalation. Compromising LSASS directly facilitates credential dumping and domain-wide attacks.
items.reason_zh: Local Security Authority Subsystem Service (LSASS) 中的释放后使用漏洞可导致本地权限提升。攻破 LSASS 将直接便利凭据转储和域级攻击。

items.reason_en: Arbitrary code execution flaw in Emacs Flymake mode allows attackers to run malicious scripts when editing untrusted files.
items.reason_zh: Emacs Flymake 模式中的任意代码执行漏洞允许攻击者在编辑不受信任的文件时运行恶意脚本。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in GIMP's GIMPressionist plug-in can corrupt memory and potentially lead to arbitrary code execution via crafted preset files.
items.reason_zh: GIMP 的 GIMPressionist 插件中的越界写入漏洞可破坏内存，并可能通过构造的预设文件导致任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Privilege escalation vulnerability in Intel VTune Profiler Ring 1 device drivers allows unauthenticated users to gain elevated system access.
items.reason_zh: Intel VTune Profiler Ring 1 设备驱动程序中的权限提升漏洞允许未经身份验证的用户获取提升的系统访问权限。

items.reason_en: Sandbox escape in bubblewrap enables attackers to follow symlinks outside restricted directories, writing files as the launching user.
items.reason_zh: bubblewrap 中的沙箱逃逸漏洞使攻击者能够跟踪受限目录外的符号链接，并以启动用户的身份写入文件。

items.reason_en: Untrusted search path in Adobe Premiere Pro allows attackers to execute arbitrary code in the user context by manipulating library loading order.
items.reason_zh: Adobe Premiere Pro 中的不受信任的搜索路径漏洞允许攻击者通过操纵库加载顺序在用户上下文中执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in Premiere Pro enables arbitrary code execution when users open malicious files, directly threatening workstation security for creative professionals.
items.reason_zh: Premiere Pro 中的越界写入漏洞在使用户打开恶意文件时可导致任意代码执行，直接威胁创意专业人士的工作站安全。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free flaw in Photoshop Desktop allows RCE upon processing crafted media, highlighting persistent risks in standard desktop application workflows.
items.reason_zh: Photoshop Desktop 中的释放后使用漏洞在处理构造的媒体文件时可导致远程代码执行，凸显了标准桌面应用程序工作流中持续存在的风险。

items.reason_en: Origin validation error in Zoom Workplace for Windows enables unauthenticated privilege escalation via network access, compromising endpoint integrity.
items.reason_zh: Windows 版 Zoom Workplace 中的源验证错误漏洞允许通过网络连接实现无需身份验证的权限提升，破坏终端完整性。

items.reason_en: Command injection in the Fluxbox window manager allows arbitrary code execution via crafted theme background values, directly compromising desktop environments.
items.reason_zh: Fluxbox 窗口管理器中的命令注入漏洞可通过构造的主题背景值实现任意代码执行，直接破坏桌面环境。

items.reason_en: Heap-based out-of-bounds write in LibreCAD's DWG parser enables potential remote code execution when processing malicious CAD files.
items.reason_zh: LibreCAD 的 DWG 解析器中的基于堆的越界写入漏洞在处理恶意 CAD 文件时可能导致潜在的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Flawed remote session detection in pam_usb bypasses security controls, potentially allowing unauthorized local authentication on Linux systems.
items.reason_zh: pam_usb 中缺陷的远程会话检测机制绕过了安全控制，可能在 Linux 系统中允许未经授权的本地认证。

items.reason_en: Android PingTools application suffers from OS command injection in its ICMP Watcher service, allowing local attackers to execute arbitrary host commands.
items.reason_zh: Android PingTools 应用程序的 ICMP Watcher 服务存在操作系统命令注入漏洞，允许本地攻击者执行任意主机命令。

items.reason_en: Code injection in Microsoft Teams for Android enables network-based spoofing attacks, undermining mobile communication integrity and user trust.
items.reason_zh: Android 版 Microsoft Teams 中的代码注入漏洞可实现基于网络的欺骗攻击，破坏移动通信完整性和用户信任。

items.reason_en: Compromises mobile communication integrity by allowing network-based spoofing attacks against the Android client due to origin validation failures.
items.reason_zh: 由于源验证失败，允许针对 Android 客户端发起基于网络的欺骗攻击，从而破坏移动通信完整性。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Modern Device Management (MDM) enables local privilege escalation, compromising enterprise mobile device compliance and configuration enforcement.
items.reason_zh: Windows Modern Device Management (MDM) 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致本地权限提升，破坏企业移动设备的合规性与配置强制执行。

items.reason_en: Critical heap-based buffer overflow in Xbox firmware permits unauthenticated remote code execution over the network. This poses a significant risk to gaming consoles and their connected ecosystems.
items.reason_zh: Xbox 固件中的严重基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过网络进行无需身份验证的远程代码执行。这对游戏主机及其连接生态系统构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: Allows third-party applications to perform arbitrary file writes with elevated privileges on Lenovo tablets. This breaks mobile device sandboxing and could lead to full system compromise.
items.reason_zh: 允许第三方应用在 Lenovo 平板电脑上以高权限执行任意文件写入。这破坏了移动设备沙箱隔离机制，可能导致完全的系统沦陷。

items.reason_en: NervesHub's device API lacks proper cross-organization isolation, enabling authenticated managers to modify device attributes and JITP settings across tenant boundaries.
items.reason_zh: NervesHub 的设备 API 缺乏适当的跨组织隔离机制，使得经过身份验证的管理员能够跨越租户边界修改设备属性和 JITP 设置。

items.reason_en: Dell OpenManage Ansible Modules contain improper certificate validation in the iDRACRedfishAPI component, risking unauthorized access to server hardware management interfaces.
items.reason_zh: Dell OpenManage Ansible Modules 的 iDRACRedfishAPI 组件存在证书验证不当问题，可能导致攻击者未经授权访问服务器硬件管理接口。

items.reason_en: Traccar's LDAP provider incorrectly accepts empty passwords, allowing unauthenticated attackers to perform anonymous binds and gain unauthorized access to tracking dashboards.
items.reason_zh: Traccar 的 LDAP 提供程序错误地接受空密码，允许未认证的攻击者执行匿名绑定并未经授权访问跟踪仪表板。

items.reason_en: Integer underflow in HID Parser Library allows network-accessible privilege escalation, creating risks for connected smart peripherals and input devices.
items.reason_zh: HID Parser Library 存在整数下溢漏洞，可导致网络可访问的权限提升，对连接的智能外设和输入设备构成风险。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication on NETGEAR RAX routers allows network-adjacent attackers to tamper with device configurations and steal administrator credentials.
items.reason_zh: NETGEAR RAX 路由器存在身份验证缺失漏洞，允许网络相邻的攻击者篡改设备配置并窃取管理员凭据。

items.reason_en: Remote information disclosure in Wellav WES Emergency Broadcast Terminals exposes sensitive data through an unprotected global API wrapper function.
items.reason_zh: Wellav WES Emergency Broadcast Terminals 存在远程信息泄露漏洞，通过未受保护的全局 API 包装函数暴露敏感数据。

items.reason_en: Path traversal vulnerability in Kobikom PBX systems permits unauthorized access to restricted filesystem directories and sensitive configuration files.
items.reason_zh: Kobikom PBX 系统存在路径遍历漏洞，允许未经授权访问受限的文件系统目录和敏感配置文件。

items.reason_en: Command injection chain in ASUS router firmware triggers from unauthenticated nearby users, allowing full device compromise and lateral network movement.
items.reason_zh: ASUS 路由器固件中存在命令注入链，可由未认证的附近用户触发，导致设备完全沦陷及横向网络移动。

items.reason_en: Remote buffer overflow in TOTOLINK router CGI handler permits persistent attacker control over edge networking hardware with released exploits.
items.reason_zh: TOTOLINK 路由器 CGI 处理程序存在远程缓冲区溢出漏洞，结合已公开的利用代码，可使攻击者持久控制边缘网络设备。

items.reason_en: Self-hosted taOS AI agent OS executes built-in skills like arbitrary Python code without verifying administrative roles, risking full system compromise.
items.reason_zh: 自托管的 taOS AI agent OS 在未验证管理员角色的情况下执行内置技能（如任意 Python 代码），可能导致系统完全沦陷。

items.reason_en: Heym agentic workflow engine accepts and executes arbitrary Python code strings in Playwright nodes, bypassing intended sandbox restrictions.
items.reason_zh: Heym agentic workflow engine 在 Playwright 节点中接受并执行任意 Python 代码字符串，绕过了预期的沙箱限制。

items.reason_en: Konflux UI proxy inserts unsanitized hostname values into configuration files, enabling authenticated users to inject malicious proxy settings.
items.reason_zh: Konflux UI proxy 将未过滤的主机名值插入配置文件，使已认证的用户能够注入恶意代理设置。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Amazon's mcp-gateway-registry external API allows authenticated users to escalate privileges and grant themselves administrative control over all registered gateways.
items.reason_zh: Amazon 的 mcp-gateway-registry 外部 API 存在授权缺失漏洞，允许已认证用户提升权限并为自身授予对所有注册网关的管理员控制权。

items.reason_en: blueprintUE's Docker Compose examples ship with insecure defaults that expose MariaDB without a password, enabling immediate database takeover by unauthenticated attackers.
items.reason_zh: blueprintUE 的 Docker Compose 示例附带不安全的默认配置，导致 MariaDB 无需密码即可暴露，使未认证的攻击者能够立即接管数据库。

items.reason_en: Rote's OAuth merge endpoint suffers from an authorization bypass that lets users forcibly link arbitrary external accounts, leading to full account takeover and data exfiltration.
items.reason_zh: Rote 的 OAuth 合并端点存在授权绕过漏洞，允许用户强制关联任意外部账户，从而导致完整的账户接管和数据外泄。

items.reason_en: Improper certificate validation in Dell Ansible Storage APIs exposes management interfaces to unauthenticated information disclosure and unauthorized access.
items.reason_zh: Dell Ansible Storage APIs 存在证书验证不当问题，导致管理接口面临未认证的信息泄露和未经授权访问的风险。

items.reason_en: Authentication weakness in Active Directory Domain Services allows privilege escalation, threatening identity management and hybrid cloud access controls.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Domain Services 存在身份验证弱点，可导致权限提升，威胁身份管理及混合云访问控制。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Aspire allows unauthorized network bypass, directly threatening cloud-native application integrity and multi-tenant isolation.
items.reason_zh: Aspire 存在授权缺失漏洞，可导致未经授权的越权访问，直接威胁云原生应用完整性与多租户隔离机制。

items.reason_en: Command injection in Azure Pipelines compromises CI/CD workflows, potentially enabling full infrastructure takeover and downstream supply chain contamination.
items.reason_zh: Azure Pipelines 存在命令注入漏洞，会破坏 CI/CD 工作流，可能导致基础设施完全沦陷及下游供应链污染。

items.reason_en: Improper privilege management in Azure Kubernetes Service could lead to container escapes or unauthorized node access within cloud clusters.
items.reason_zh: Azure Kubernetes Service 存在权限管理不当问题，可能导致容器逃逸或云集群内的未经授权节点访问。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization controls in Azure Confidential Clean Rooms enable network-based tampering with sensitive, isolated workloads.
items.reason_zh: Azure Confidential Clean Rooms 存在授权控制缺失漏洞，使得基于网络的敏感隔离工作负载篡改成为可能。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in Azure OpenAI allows unauthorized network privilege escalation, risking direct compromise of AI infrastructure and tenant data.
items.reason_zh: Azure OpenAI 存在身份验证缺失漏洞，可导致网络层面的权限提升，危及 AI 基础设施及租户数据的直接沦陷。

items.reason_en: Authorization flaws in Microsoft Graph enable attackers to escalate privileges across cloud directories, disrupting enterprise identity management.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Graph 存在授权缺陷，使攻击者能够在云目录间提升权限，破坏企业身份管理机制。

items.reason_en: SSRF vulnerability in Azure Managed Grafana permits unauthorized network pivoting and potential credential theft from internal endpoints.
items.reason_zh: Azure Managed Grafana 存在 SSRF 漏洞，允许未经授权的跨网段跳转及从内部端点窃取凭据。

items.reason_en: Misconfigured permissions in Azure Front Door allow attackers to elevate privileges over the network, exposing backend resources to unauthorized access.
items.reason_zh: Azure Front Door 存在权限配置错误问题，使攻击者能够通过网络提升权限，导致后端资源暴露于未经授权的访问之下。

items.reason_en: Directly impacts cloud workload orchestration security by exposing sensitive configuration data through restricted directory path traversal.
items.reason_zh: 该漏洞通过受限目录的路径遍历暴露敏感配置数据，直接影响云工作负载编排的安全性。

items.reason_en: Hypervisor flaws risk multi-tenant isolation; this TOCTOU race condition allows local attackers to bypass security controls within Hyper-V.
items.reason_zh: 虚拟机监控程序漏洞威胁多租户隔离性；此 TOCTOU 竞态条件允许本地攻击者绕过 Hyper-V 内部的安全控制。

items.reason_en: Critical for virtualized cloud environments, enabling local attackers to escalate privileges through unsafe memory dereferencing in the Hyper-V driver.
items.reason_zh: 该漏洞对虚拟化云环境影响重大，允许本地攻击者通过 Hyper-V 驱动中的不安全内存解引用实现权限提升。

items.reason_en: Authenticated network authorization bypass in Azure DevOps Server compromises CI/CD pipelines and sensitive source code repositories.
items.reason_zh: Azure DevOps Server 存在已认证的网络授权绕过漏洞，会破坏 CI/CD 流水线及敏感源代码仓库。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypass in Microsoft MCP Gateway allows network attackers to escalate privileges, threatening cloud-managed identity and access control planes.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft MCP Gateway 存在授权绕过漏洞，允许网络攻击者提升权限，威胁云管理的身份与访问控制平面。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication in Azure DevOps allows an attacker to execute code remotely over the network. Given its role in CI/CD pipelines, exploitation could lead to widespread codebase and secret theft.
items.reason_zh: Azure DevOps 存在身份验证不当问题，允许攻击者通过网络远程执行代码。鉴于其在 CI/CD 流水线中的作用，利用该漏洞可能导致广泛的代码库及密钥泄露。

items.reason_en: Flaw in Red Hat Quay allows unauthenticated clients to manipulate registry tokens and install unauthorized signing keys. This breaks container image verification and compromises software supply chain integrity.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat Quay 中的缺陷允许未认证客户端操纵注册表令牌并安装未经授权的签名密钥。这会破坏容器镜像验证并损害软件供应链完整性。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in Azure CLI enables remote code execution by authorized users. This undermines cloud management workflows and could allow lateral movement within Azure environments.
items.reason_zh: Azure CLI 中的操作系统命令注入漏洞使授权用户能够执行远程代码。这会破坏云管理工作流，并可能允许在 Azure 环境中进行横向移动。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in Kubero allows unauthenticated attackers to forge administrative JWTs using a hardcoded fallback secret, granting full platform control.
items.reason_zh: Kubero 中的身份验证绕过漏洞允许未认证攻击者使用硬编码的回退密钥伪造管理员 JWT，从而获得完整的平台控制权。

items.reason_en: Jinja2 template injection in Ansible Operator Plugins enables low-privileged Kubernetes users to execute arbitrary commands via crafted custom resources.
items.reason_zh: Ansible Operator Plugins 中的 Jinja2 模板注入漏洞使低权限 Kubernetes 用户能够通过构造的自定义资源执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in Checkmk's host label synchronization allows distributed site attackers to write arbitrary files and achieve remote code execution on central monitoring servers.
items.reason_zh: Checkmk 主机标签同步功能中的路径遍历漏洞允许分布式站点攻击者写入任意文件，并在中央监控服务器上实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Critical path traversal and input validation flaws in IBM API Connect allow authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code and breach multi-tenant isolation.
items.reason_zh: IBM API Connect 中严重的路径遍历和输入验证缺陷允许已认证攻击者执行任意代码并突破多租户隔离。

items.reason_en: Critical SSRF in Adobe Connect requires no user interaction and changes scope, enabling unauthenticated attackers to escalate privileges and compromise cloud tenants.
items.reason_zh: Adobe Connect 中的高危 SSRF 漏洞无需用户交互且影响范围扩大，使未认证攻击者能够提升权限并危及云租户安全。

items.reason_en: Code injection in Adobe Experience Manager allows low-privileged users to execute arbitrary code, threatening enterprise content management infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Adobe Experience Manager 中的代码注入漏洞使低权限用户能够执行任意代码，威胁企业内容管理基础设施。

items.reason_en: Permission validation flaw in Octopus Deploy grants unauthorized users system administrator access, risking CI/CD pipeline and deployment environment integrity.
items.reason_zh: Octopus Deploy 中的权限验证缺陷授予未授权用户系统管理员访问权限，危及 CI/CD 流水线及部署环境的完整性。

items.reason_en: Critical authorization bypass in Microsoft Entra Device Registration enables unauthorized privilege escalation and full network control.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Entra Device Registration 中的高危授权绕过漏洞使未授权用户能够提升权限并完全控制网络。

items.reason_en: Severe input validation flaw in IBM API Connect allows cross-site scripting and sensitive data exfiltration by authenticated users.
items.reason_zh: IBM API Connect 中严重的输入验证缺陷允许已认证用户进行跨站脚本攻击并窃取敏感数据。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery vulnerability permits attackers to bypass security restrictions and access internal cloud resources.
items.reason_zh: 服务端请求伪造漏洞允许攻击者绕过安全限制并访问内部云资源。

items.reason_en: Improper output encoding in FortiAnalyzer and FortiManager enables remote unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious payloads across multiple Fortinet appliances.
items.reason_zh: FortiAnalyzer 和 FortiManager 中的输出编码不当漏洞使远程未认证攻击者能够在多个 Fortinet 设备上注入恶意载荷。

items.reason_en: FortiMail path traversal vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to navigate directory structures and execute unauthorized system commands.
items.reason_zh: FortiMail 的路径遍历漏洞允许未认证攻击者遍历目录结构并执行未授权的系统命令。

items.reason_en: Numeric truncation errors in FortiOS permit configured iBGP neighbors to inject malicious routing attributes, potentially destabilizing network infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: FortiOS 中的数值截断错误允许配置的 iBGP 邻居注入恶意路由属性，可能导致网络基础设施不稳定。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication for critical functions in FortiOS allows unauthenticated attackers with HA or config-sync access to execute commands as a super administrator.
items.reason_zh: FortiOS 关键功能缺少身份验证机制，使拥有 HA 或配置同步访问权限的未认证攻击者能够以超级管理员身份执行命令。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in FortiMail enables authenticated attackers to execute unauthorized database queries, compromising email security and log integrity.
items.reason_zh: FortiMail 中的 SQL 注入漏洞使已认证攻击者能够执行未授权的数据库查询，破坏邮件安全性和日志完整性。

items.reason_en: Fortinet FortiMail contains an unauthenticated OS command injection vulnerability triggered via crafted HA join-request packets, granting full system control.
items.reason_zh: Fortinet FortiMail 存在未认证的操作系统命令注入漏洞，可通过构造的 HA 加入请求数据包触发，从而获取完整的系统控制权。

items.reason_en: Authentication flaws in Fortinet FortiMail allow unauthenticated attackers to bypass login mechanisms and access other users' secure email accounts via crafted HTTP requests.
items.reason_zh: Fortinet FortiMail 的身份验证缺陷允许未认证攻击者绕过登录机制，并通过构造的 HTTP 请求访问其他用户的安全邮箱账户。

items.reason_en: Lenovo XClarity Integrator for Windows Admin Center permits authenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary PowerShell commands by submitting maliciously crafted hostnames.
items.reason_zh: 用于 Windows Admin Center 的 Lenovo XClarity Integrator 允许已认证远程攻击者通过提交恶意构造的主机名执行任意 PowerShell 命令。

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in Windows DNS Server allows remote code execution, threatening critical network resolution infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS Server 中的非信任指针解引用漏洞可导致远程代码执行，威胁关键的网络解析基础设施。

items.reason_en: Command injection in Active Directory permits network-based privilege escalation, enabling attackers to hijack domain controllers.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory 中的命令注入漏洞允许基于网络的提权，使攻击者能够劫持域控制器。

items.reason_en: Weak authentication mechanisms in AD DS facilitate lateral movement and unauthorized network access across enterprise environments.
items.reason_zh: AD DS 中的弱身份验证机制助长了横向移动和跨企业环境的未授权网络访问。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in Windows DNS can disclose sensitive information over a network when processing malformed queries, undermining resolution reliability.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 在处理畸形查询时发生的整数溢出漏洞可在网络上泄露敏感信息，破坏解析可靠性。

items.reason_en: Integer underflow in Microsoft QUIC triggers denial-of-service conditions over a network by exploiting packet processing logic in encrypted transport streams.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft QUIC 中的整数下溢漏洞通过利用加密传输流中的数据包处理逻辑，在网络层面触发拒绝服务条件。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in Windows iSCSI allows remote code execution over storage networks, compromising block-level data access systems.
items.reason_zh: Windows iSCSI 中的释放后使用漏洞允许在存储网络上执行远程代码，破坏块级数据访问系统。

items.reason_en: DNS infrastructure is foundational to network operations; uninitialized resources here allow adjacent attackers to execute code remotely.
items.reason_zh: DNS 基础设施是网络运行的基础；此处的未初始化资源允许相邻攻击者远程执行代码。

items.reason_en: Affects core network stack stability and security, permitting adjacent attackers to achieve remote code execution via TCP/IP use-after-free.
items.reason_zh: 该漏洞影响核心网络栈的稳定性和安全性，允许相邻攻击者通过 TCP/IP 释放后使用漏洞实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Impacts network address translation services, allowing attackers to execute code remotely over the network through a NAT heap overflow.
items.reason_zh: 该漏洞影响网络地址转换服务，允许攻击者通过 NAT 堆溢出在网络层面远程执行代码。

items.reason_en: Threatens secure tunnel availability by enabling attackers to exhaust system resources remotely via the SSTP protocol.
items.reason_zh: 该漏洞威胁安全隧道的可用性，使攻击者能够通过 SSTP 协议远程耗尽系统资源。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated network RCE in DHCP Server disrupts critical IP address management and allows complete server takeover by remote attackers.
items.reason_zh: DHCP Server中的未授权网络远程代码执行漏洞会破坏关键的IP地址管理功能，并允许远程攻击者完全接管服务器。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated network RCE in DHCP Server exposes core network infrastructure to remote exploitation without prior authentication.
items.reason_zh: DHCP Server中的未授权网络远程代码执行漏洞使核心网络基础设施在无需预先认证的情况下暴露于远程利用风险中。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated network RCE in DNS Server enables attackers to compromise name resolution services and potentially redirect traffic remotely.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server中的未授权网络远程代码执行漏洞使攻击者能够破坏名称解析服务，并可能远程重定向流量。

items.reason_en: Authenticated network RCE in DNS Server allows privileged attackers to execute code remotely on critical infrastructure components.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server中的需认证网络远程代码执行漏洞允许拥有特权的攻击者在关键基础设施组件上远程执行代码。

items.reason_en: Double free in Windows DNS permits unauthorized network attackers to execute code remotely, disrupting critical name resolution services.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS中的双重释放漏洞允许未经授权的网络攻击者远程执行代码，从而破坏关键的名称解析服务。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in DNS Server allows remote code execution, compromising network routing and internal service discovery.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server中的释放后使用（UAF）漏洞可导致远程代码执行，进而破坏网络路由和内部服务发现机制。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Windows Client for NFS enables network-level privilege escalation, affecting cross-platform file sharing environments.
items.reason_zh: Windows Client for NFS中的释放后使用漏洞可实现网络级权限提升，影响跨平台文件共享环境。

items.reason_en: Double free in Windows DHCP Client allows adjacent network attackers to elevate privileges, risking IP allocation and network segmentation.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Client中的双重释放漏洞允许相邻网络攻击者提升权限，危及IP分配和网络分段安全。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Windows DNS allows unauthenticated remote code execution. As a core network resolution service, this flaw can disrupt enterprise DNS infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS中的不信任数据反序列化漏洞可导致未授权远程代码执行。作为核心网络解析服务，此缺陷可能破坏企业DNS基础设施。

items.reason_en: Double-fetch vulnerability in DPDK vhost-crypto allows malicious guests to trigger out-of-bounds host access. This impacts high-performance virtualized networking and data plane security.
items.reason_zh: DPDK vhost-crypto中的双重获取漏洞允许恶意客户机触发越界主机访问。这会影响高性能虚拟化网络和数据平面安全。

items.reason_en: Missing bounds checking in DPDK GSO library causes header payload underflows during packet processing. This can corrupt network buffers and destabilize virtualized network functions.
items.reason_zh: DPDK GSO library中缺失的边界检查会在数据包处理过程中导致头部载荷下溢。这可能损坏网络缓冲区并导致虚拟化网络功能失稳。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Ivanti Endpoint Manager Core enables unauthenticated remote attackers to achieve full remote code execution on managed networks.
items.reason_zh: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Core中的SQL注入漏洞使未授权远程攻击者能够在受管网络上实现完整的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Memory corruption vulnerability in SAP NetWeaver ABAP Application Server allows unauthenticated attackers to trigger remote code execution via crafted network traffic.
items.reason_zh: SAP NetWeaver ABAP Application Server中的内存破坏漏洞允许未授权攻击者通过构造的网络流量触发远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: SAP Gateway default ACL activation misclassification allows unauthenticated network attackers to bypass security boundaries and perform unauthorized actions.
items.reason_zh: SAP Gateway的默认ACL激活误分类漏洞使未授权网络攻击者能够绕过安全边界并执行未授权操作。

items.reason_en: Improper code generation control in IBM API Connect management service allows attackers to execute arbitrary code through unsanitized customization content.
items.reason_zh: IBM API Connect管理服务中的代码生成控制不当漏洞允许攻击者通过未经清理的自定义内容执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in Barracuda Email Security Gateway allows restoration of crafted backups to modify global configurations; actively exploited in the wild (CISA KEV).
items.reason_zh: Barracuda Email Security Gateway的身份验证绕过漏洞允许通过还原构造的备份来修改全局配置；该漏洞已在野外被积极利用（CISA KEV）。

items.reason_en: Shell metacharacter injection in Barracuda timezone configuration enables authenticated administrators to execute root commands, representing a critical appliance vulnerability.
items.reason_zh: Barracuda时区配置中的Shell元字符注入漏洞允许已认证管理员执行root命令，属于关键设备漏洞。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in Checkmk Synthetic Monitoring allows agent output manipulation to inject arbitrary HTML, compromising network monitoring dashboards and alerting systems.
items.reason_zh: Checkmk Synthetic Monitoring中的路径遍历漏洞允许通过操纵代理输出注入任意HTML，从而破坏网络监控仪表板和告警系统。

items.reason_en: Publicly exploitable remote buffer overflow in TOTOLINK router firmware enables immediate device compromise and network pivoting.
items.reason_zh: TOTOLINK路由器固件中存在公开可利用的远程缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致设备立即沦陷及网络横向移动。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in FortiSandbox administrative interfaces may allow attackers to execute malicious scripts and disrupt security operations.
items.reason_zh: FortiSandbox管理界面中的跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞可能使攻击者能够执行恶意脚本并破坏安全运营。

items.reason_en: NI VeriStand Gateway lacks authorization checks for Project resources, potentially allowing remote attackers to achieve arbitrary code execution in critical test and measurement environments.
items.reason_zh: NI VeriStand Gateway缺乏对项目资源的授权检查，可能允许远程攻击者在关键测试与测量环境中实现任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in NI VeriStand Waveform Streaming Server can be exploited via specially crafted messages to execute remote code.
items.reason_zh: NI VeriStand Waveform Streaming Server中的不信任数据反序列化漏洞可通过特殊构造的消息进行利用以执行远程代码。

items.reason_en: Memory corruption in LabVIEW's tdcore.dll due to improper length checks may lead to information disclosure or arbitrary code execution when users open crafted VI files.
items.reason_zh: 由于长度检查不当，LabVIEW的tdcore.dll存在内存破坏漏洞，当用户打开构造的VI文件时可能导致信息泄露或任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Critical deserialization vulnerability in PTC Windchill and FlexPLM enables remote code execution. These platforms manage critical engineering and manufacturing data, making exploitation highly damaging.
items.reason_zh: PTC Windchill和FlexPLM中存在关键的反序列化漏洞，可导致远程代码执行。这些平台管理着关键的工程与制造数据，因此利用该漏洞会造成严重损害。

items.reason_en: Deserialization flaw in NI DAQExpress allows remote code execution when opening crafted project files. Widely used in test and measurement setups, it poses direct risks to industrial data acquisition systems.
items.reason_zh: NI DAQExpress中的反序列化缺陷在打开构造的项目文件时可导致远程代码执行。该软件广泛用于测试与测量环境，对工业数据采集系统构成直接风险。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in MEASX DASYLab occurs during string conversion of crafted files. This engineering software vulnerability can leak sensitive memory contents or crash data logging processes.
items.reason_zh: MEASX DASYLab在处理构造文件的字符串转换时会发生越界读取。此工程软件漏洞可能导致敏感内存内容泄露或数据记录进程崩溃。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Kobikom KobiPBX-FOP3 allows attackers to manipulate database queries, potentially disrupting critical telecommunication and industrial control workflows.
items.reason_zh: Kobikom KobiPBX-FOP3中的SQL注入漏洞使攻击者能够操纵数据库查询，可能破坏关键的电信与工业控制工作流。

items.reason_en: Authorization check bypass in SAP NetWeaver ABAP Platform enables low-privilege attackers to invoke internal functionality and execute operating system commands on host systems.
items.reason_zh: SAP NetWeaver ABAP Platform中的授权检查绕过漏洞使低权限攻击者能够调用内部功能并在主机系统上执行操作系统命令。

items.reason_en: Insufficient request validation in SAP Web Dispatcher and NetWeaver allows attackers to trick administrators into performing unintended actions via crafted administrative requests.
items.reason_zh: SAP Web Dispatcher和NetWeaver中的请求验证不足漏洞使攻击者能够通过构造的管理请求诱骗管理员执行非预期操作。

items.reason_en: Exposed IOCTL calls in Beckhoff TcRouter.sys allow low-privileged processes to access I/O ports, risking direct interference with industrial automation controllers.
items.reason_zh: Beckhoff TcRouter.sys中暴露的IOCTL调用允许低特权进程访问I/O端口，存在直接干扰工业自动化控制器的风险。

items.reason_en: Unrestricted physical memory access via TcRouter.sys enables complete device compromise, threatening operational technology environments and safety systems.
items.reason_zh: 通过 TcRouter.sys 获取不受限制的物理内存访问权限可导致设备被完全控制，威胁运营技术环境与安全系统。

items.reason_en: Log injection vulnerability in Johnson Controls C-CURE 9000 exposes operating system credentials, risking unauthorized access to building management systems.
items.reason_zh: Johnson Controls C-CURE 9000 中的日志注入漏洞会泄露操作系统凭据，可能导致对楼宇管理系统的未授权访问。

items.reason_en: Update mechanism flaw in Johnson Controls EasyIO Neo allows installation of malicious software, directly threatening physical security hardware.
items.reason_zh: Johnson Controls EasyIO Neo 的更新机制缺陷允许安装恶意软件，直接威胁物理安全硬件。

items.reason_en: Hardcoded API key leak in Skyline DataMiner enables unauthenticated credential retrieval, compromising industrial monitoring and control networks.
items.reason_zh: Skyline DataMiner 中硬编码的 API 密钥泄露可启用未认证凭据检索，破坏工业监控与控制网络。

items.reason_en: Livewire PowerGrid interpolates public properties directly into raw SQL ORDER BY clauses, enabling arbitrary SQL injection via targeted POST requests.
items.reason_zh: Livewire PowerGrid 将公共属性直接插值到原始 SQL ORDER BY 子句中，可通过定向 POST 请求实现任意 SQL 注入。

items.reason_en: The fulgur HTML-to-PDF converter suffers from quadratic style-list reprocessing, causing severe denial of service when processing untrusted multi-tenant inputs.
items.reason_zh: fulgur HTML-to-PDF 转换器存在平方级样式列表重处理问题，在处理不受信任的多租户输入时会引发严重的拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: A re-entrancy flaw in Node.js HTTPS allows unauthenticated clients to read memory from other connections, including TLS private keys and sensitive request data.
items.reason_zh: Node.js HTTPS 模块中的重入缺陷允许未认证客户端读取其他连接的内存，包括 TLS 私钥和敏感请求数据。

items.reason_en: Gotenberg's SSRF protection can be bypassed using IPv6 zone identifiers, enabling unauthenticated attackers to probe internal network services.
items.reason_zh: 利用 IPv6 区域标识符可绕过 Gotenberg 的 SSRF 防护，使未认证攻击者能够探测内部网络服务。

items.reason_en: Stored cross-site scripting in WWBN AVideo allows uploaders to inject malicious scripts via unescaped video download links, compromising viewer sessions.
items.reason_zh: WWBN AVideo 中存在存储型跨站脚本漏洞，上传者可通过未转义的视频下载链接注入恶意脚本，从而劫持观看者会话。

items.reason_en: Regular-expression denial of service in OWASP CRS rules can disrupt WAF operations and potentially bypass security filtering for web applications.
items.reason_zh: OWASP CRS 规则中的正则表达式拒绝服务漏洞可能干扰 WAF 运行，并可能绕过 Web 应用的安全过滤。

items.reason_en: Blind SQL injection in Revive Adserver permits authenticated managers to extract sensitive database records across agency boundaries.
items.reason_zh: Revive Adserver 中的盲注 SQL 注入漏洞允许已认证的管理员跨越机构边界提取敏感数据库记录。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Visual Studio Code enables attackers to bypass security boundaries and probe internal network resources over the network.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中的服务器端请求伪造漏洞可使攻击者突破安全边界并通过网络探测内部网络资源。

items.reason_en: Unsafe deserialization in SharePoint enables remote code execution over the network, compromising enterprise collaboration infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的不安全反序列化漏洞可在网络上实现远程代码执行，破坏企业协作基础设施。

items.reason_en: Code injection flaws in Exchange Server allow authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary commands via web and mail interfaces.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server 中的代码注入漏洞允许已认证的攻击者通过 Web 和邮件接口执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: Resource exhaustion vulnerabilities in ASP.NET Core enable denial-of-service attacks against web applications due to unthrottled allocation.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的资源耗尽漏洞因缺乏分配限制，可对 Web 应用发起拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Unsafe deserialization in SharePoint Online allows remote code execution over the network, directly impacting web application availability and data confidentiality.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint Online 中的不安全反序列化漏洞可在网络上实现远程代码执行，直接影响 Web 应用的可用性与数据机密性。

items.reason_en: SSRF in SharePoint enables attackers to probe internal networks and elevate privileges, exploiting the platform's server-side request capabilities.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的 SSRF 漏洞使攻击者能够探测内部网络并提升权限，该漏洞利用了平台的服务端请求功能。

items.reason_en: Another SSRF flaw in SharePoint highlights systemic issues in handling external requests, increasing risk of internal network reconnaissance.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的另一处 SSRF 缺陷凸显了处理外部请求时的系统性问题，增加了内部网络侦察的风险。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in SharePoint enables authorized attackers to elevate privileges over the network by injecting malicious scripts into web page generation.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的跨站脚本漏洞使已认证攻击者能够通过向网页生成过程注入恶意脚本，在网络层面提升权限。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in Microsoft JScript allows remote code execution over a network when processing maliciously crafted scripts in web environments.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft JScript 中的整数溢出漏洞在 Web 环境中处理恶意构造的脚本时，可导致网络远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Directly impacts web application availability by allowing attackers to trigger denial-of-service conditions remotely through uncontrolled resource consumption.
items.reason_zh: 攻击者可通过不受控的资源消耗远程触发拒绝服务状态，直接影响 Web 应用的可用性。

items.reason_en: Affects backend web framework security, enabling authorized attackers to escalate privileges through improper synchronization in ASP.NET Core.
items.reason_zh: 影响后端 Web 框架安全性，使已认证攻击者能够通过 ASP.NET Core 中的不当同步操作提升权限。

items.reason_en: Legacy scripting engine poses an ongoing web threat, allowing remote attackers to execute code via crafted scripts exploiting integer overflow.
items.reason_zh: 遗留脚本引擎构成持续的 Web 威胁，允许远程攻击者通过利用整数溢出的构造脚本执行代码。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows HTTP.sys enables local privilege escalation, historically linked to critical web server exploits and remote code execution chains.
items.reason_zh: Windows HTTP.sys 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致本地权限提升，历史上常与关键 Web 服务器漏洞利用及远程代码执行链相关联。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication and integrity validation in a WooCommerce payment module allows API message manipulation via MITM. This directly threatens financial transaction security and customer data.
items.reason_zh: WooCommerce 支付模块中缺失的身份验证与完整性校验允许通过中间人攻击篡改 API 消息，直接威胁金融交易安全与客户数据。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables remote code execution. As a cornerstone enterprise collaboration platform, this flaw requires immediate patching to prevent lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中对不受信任数据进行反序列化可导致远程代码执行。作为核心企业协作平台，该缺陷需立即修补以防止横向移动。

items.reason_en: Cross-site request forgery in the Webriti Wallstreet Agency WordPress plugin allows attackers to perform unauthorized actions on behalf of authenticated users. Highlights ongoing risks in the WordPress plugin ecosystem.
items.reason_zh: Webriti Wallstreet Agency WordPress 插件中存在跨站请求伪造漏洞，允许攻击者以已认证用户的名义执行未授权操作，凸显了 WordPress 插件生态持续存在的风险。

items.reason_en: Arbitrary file deletion and exfiltration vulnerability in Ninja Forms File Uploads WordPress plugin compromises website integrity and sensitive stored data.
items.reason_zh: Ninja Forms File Uploads WordPress 插件中的任意文件删除与数据外泄漏洞破坏了网站完整性及敏感存储数据。

items.reason_en: Cross-Site Request Forgery in Apache Roller allows unauthenticated attackers to create administrator accounts by exploiting missing token validation on administrative POST requests.
items.reason_zh: Apache Roller 中的跨站请求伪造漏洞使未认证攻击者能够通过利用管理 POST 请求中缺失的令牌校验来创建管理员账户。

items.reason_en: Heap buffer overflow in libsoup WebSocket implementation triggers memory corruption when handling large compressed messages, enabling potential remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: libsoup WebSocket 实现中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞在处理大型压缩消息时会触发内存损坏，可能导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Denial of service vulnerability in Erlang/OTP httpd allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust server resources by stalling connections with malformed headers.
items.reason_zh: Erlang/OTP httpd 中的拒绝服务漏洞允许未认证的攻击者通过畸形请求头挂起连接，从而耗尽服务器资源。

items.reason_en: Access control bypass in Contao backend file manager permits restricted users to modify folders outside their designated mount points.
items.reason_zh: Contao 后端文件管理器中的访问控制绕过漏洞允许受限用户修改其指定挂载点之外的文件夹。

items.reason_en: Arbitrary file upload vulnerability in WordPress ARForms plugin allows attackers to bypass restrictions via request headers, facilitating web shell deployment.
items.reason_zh: WordPress ARForms 插件中的任意文件上传漏洞允许攻击者通过请求头绕过限制，从而部署 Webshell。

items.reason_en: Stored XSS in Joomla iCagenda extension enables persistent script injection through event URLs, compromising user sessions and data integrity across web portals.
items.reason_zh: Joomla iCagenda 扩展程序中的存储型跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞允许通过事件 URL 进行持久化脚本注入，破坏 Web 门户的用户会话与数据完整性。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in hMailServer database layer permits remote attackers to alter SQL statements, exposing sensitive email metadata and user credentials.
items.reason_zh: hMailServer 数据库层中的 SQL 注入漏洞允许远程攻击者篡改 SQL 语句，导致敏感邮件元数据和用户凭据泄露。

items.reason_en: Hardcoded JWT secret in AstroBlocks CMS allows complete admin session forgery, granting full platform control to attackers.
items.reason_zh: AstroBlocks CMS 中硬编码的 JWT 密钥允许完全伪造管理员会话，使攻击者获得平台完全控制权。

items.reason_en: Unsanitized markdown preview in Waline comment system triggers severe cross-site scripting, compromising end-user browsers.
items.reason_zh: Waline 评论系统中未过滤的 Markdown 预览功能会触发严重的跨站脚本攻击，危及终端用户浏览器安全。

items.reason_en: Social login display name manipulation bypasses authentication in WWBN AVideo, enabling instant account takeover of any user.
items.reason_zh: WWBN AVideo 中社交登录显示名称的操纵可绕过身份验证，实现任意用户的即时账户接管。

items.reason_en: Privilege escalation in Craft CMS via unchecked PHP callables allows authenticated users to promote arbitrary accounts to administrators.
items.reason_zh: Craft CMS 中未经检查的 PHP 可调用对象可导致权限提升，使已认证用户将任意账户提升为管理员。

items.reason_en: WebSocket authentication bypass in Directus skips permission checks, exposing restricted content to unauthenticated attackers.
items.reason_zh: Directus 中的 WebSocket 身份验证绕过漏洞跳过了权限检查，使未认证攻击者能够访问受限内容。

items.reason_en: Portabase database backup tool contains a path traversal flaw in its TUS upload webhook handler, allowing unauthenticated attackers to overwrite critical system files.
items.reason_zh: Portabase 数据库备份工具的 TUS 上传 Webhook 处理程序存在路径遍历缺陷，允许未认证攻击者覆盖关键系统文件。

items.reason_en: NI SystemLink Server bundles an outdated Redis version susceptible to CVE-2022-24834, leaving deployed instances vulnerable to known exploitation techniques.
items.reason_zh: NI SystemLink Server 捆绑了易受 CVE-2022-24834 影响的过时 Redis 版本，导致已部署实例面临已知利用技术的威胁。

items.reason_en: BusyBox httpd's reverse proxy feature mishandles pipelined HTTP requests, allowing attackers to bypass URL prefix restrictions and relay verbatim requests to backend servers.
items.reason_zh: BusyBox httpd 的反向代理功能对流水线 HTTP 请求处理不当，允许攻击者绕过 URL 前缀限制并将原始请求转发至后端服务器。

items.reason_en: TinaCMS's MDX serializer fails to escape rich-text values, enabling authenticated content editors to inject and execute arbitrary code within stored markdown files.
items.reason_zh: TinaCMS 的 MDX 序列化器未能正确转义富文本值，使已认证的内容编辑人员能够在存储的 Markdown 文件中注入并执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: High-severity heap buffer overflow in SQL Server allows unauthorized remote code execution, posing a critical risk to data infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的高危堆缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未授权的远程代码执行，对数据基础设施构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: SQL injection vulnerability in SQL Server enables authorized attackers to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary commands over the network.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的 SQL 注入漏洞使已认证攻击者能够提升权限并通过网络执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: Race condition in Windows IIS can lead to remote code execution, impacting widely deployed web hosting and application services that handle sensitive data.
items.reason_zh: Windows IIS 中的竞争条件漏洞可能导致远程代码执行，影响广泛部署的处理敏感数据的 Web 托管与应用服务。

items.reason_en: Exposed dangerous methods in SQL Server can be leveraged for privilege escalation or unauthorized administrative actions over the network.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中暴露的危险方法可被用于提升权限或通过网络执行未授权的管理操作。

items.reason_en: Inefficient algorithmic complexity in the .NET runtime facilitates resource exhaustion attacks targeting backend middleware services.
items.reason_zh: .NET 运行时中低效的算法复杂度会导致针对后端中间件服务的资源耗尽攻击。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypasses in SharePoint allow elevated access to restricted functions, undermining data governance in enterprise environments.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的授权绕过漏洞允许越权访问受限功能，破坏企业环境中的数据治理。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server enables remote code execution over a network, posing a severe threat to enterprise data infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞支持通过网络进行远程代码执行，对企业数据基础设施构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: Cryptographic signature verification failure in the SQL Server JDBC driver allows attackers to bypass security features and intercept or tamper with database traffic.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server JDBC 驱动程序的加密签名验证失败漏洞允许攻击者绕过安全特性并拦截或篡改数据库流量。

items.reason_en: Authenticated network RCE in SQL Server heap overflow enables attackers to execute arbitrary code on database instances.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 堆溢出漏洞导致的已认证网络远程代码执行（RCE）使攻击者能够在数据库实例上执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Authenticated network privilege escalation in SQL Server stack overflow allows attackers to gain elevated control over database systems.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 栈溢出漏洞导致的已认证网络权限提升使攻击者能够获得对数据库系统的更高控制权。

items.reason_en: Authenticated network RCE in SQL Server heap overflow poses significant risk to enterprise data platforms and application backends.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 堆溢出漏洞导致的已认证网络远程代码执行对企业数据平台和应用程序后端构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server enables unauthorized network attackers to execute arbitrary code, posing a severe risk to backend data infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞使未授权的网络攻击者能够执行任意代码，对后端数据基础设施构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: Similar heap overflow in SQL Server allows network-based code execution, directly threatening database integrity and availability.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中类似的堆溢出漏洞允许基于网络的代码执行，直接威胁数据库的完整性与可用性。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server allows authenticated attackers to execute code remotely. Exploitation could lead to full database compromise and exfiltration of sensitive corporate data.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许已认证攻击者远程执行代码。利用该漏洞可能导致数据库完全失陷及敏感企业数据泄露。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Microsoft WDAC OLE DB provider enables unauthenticated remote code execution. This database connectivity driver flaw impacts middleware integration layers.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft WDAC OLE DB 提供程序中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未认证的远程代码执行。该数据库连接驱动程序缺陷会影响中间件集成层。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass via capture-replay in SQL Server allows unauthorized information disclosure. This undermines connection security and could expose sensitive query results or metadata.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中通过捕获重放实现的身份验证绕过漏洞允许未授权的信息披露。这会破坏连接安全性，并可能暴露敏感的查询结果或元数据。

items.reason_en: Insecure deserialization in IBM MQ allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on consumer applications by sending malicious ObjectMessage payloads.
items.reason_zh: IBM MQ中的不安全反序列化允许经过身份验证的攻击者通过发送恶意的ObjectMessage有效载荷，在消费者应用程序上执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Double-free error in libxml2 Python bindings triggered by crafted XML DTDs can corrupt memory and lead to remote code execution in middleware services.
items.reason_zh: libxml2 Python绑定中由构造的XML DTD触发的双重释放错误可导致内存损坏，并引发中间件服务中的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in Hex package manager allows malicious publishers to delete project dependencies and extract files outside restricted directories during fetch operations.
items.reason_zh: Hex包管理器中的路径遍历漏洞允许恶意发布者在执行拉取操作时删除项目依赖项，并将文件提取到受限目录之外。

items.reason_en: Oversized Subject Alternative Name in GnuTLS causes certificate validation fallback to Common Name, enabling potential man-in-the-middle attacks against secure middleware connections.
items.reason_zh: GnuTLS中过大的Subject Alternative Name会导致证书验证回退至Common Name，从而可能针对安全中间件连接实施中间人攻击。

items.reason_en: Prefix-based OIDC subject identifier comparison in SSSD allows attackers with matching IdP prefixes to bypass authentication checks and impersonate legitimate users.
items.reason_zh: SSSD中基于前缀的OIDC主体标识符比较机制允许拥有匹配IdP前缀的攻击者绕过身份验证检查并冒充合法用户。

items.reason_en: SAP NetWeaver lacks authorization checks on remote interfaces, allowing low-privileged attackers to inject and execute arbitrary code within enterprise middleware.
items.reason_zh: SAP NetWeaver在远程接口上缺乏授权检查，使得低权限攻击者能够在企业中间件中注入并执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Authentication assertion verification failure in SAP NetWeaver AS ABAP enables unauthenticated impersonation of privileged accounts, risking core business logic execution.
items.reason_zh: SAP NetWeaver AS ABAP中的身份验证断言验证失败漏洞使得未授权攻击者能够冒充特权账户，危及核心业务逻辑的执行。

items.reason_en: Memory corruption in Nitrite database during legacy store initialization allows attackers to trigger crashes or potential code execution, affecting embedded NoSQL deployments.
items.reason_zh: Nitrite数据库在旧版存储初始化期间的内存损坏漏洞允许攻击者触发崩溃或潜在代码执行，影响嵌入式NoSQL部署。

items.reason_en: Improperly escaped date variables in Chartbrew's MongoDB queries enable NoSQL injection, risking data manipulation and exfiltration.
items.reason_zh: Chartbrew的MongoDB查询中日期变量转义不当会引发NoSQL注入，导致数据被篡改或外泄的风险。
