items.reason_en: Object instantiation flaw in Symfony Serializer allows attacker-controlled file path resolution, leading to potential information disclosure.
items.reason_zh: Symfony Serializer中的对象实例化缺陷允许攻击者控制文件路径解析，可能导致信息泄露。

items.reason_en: The aeon-toolkit GitHub Actions workflow uses pull_request_target for pre-commit checks, allowing fork-controlled code to execute privileged workflows and compromise CI/CD pipelines.
items.reason_zh: aeon-toolkit的GitHub Actions工作流在预提交检查中使用pull_request_target，允许受控于Fork的代码执行特权工作流并破坏CI/CD流水线。

items.reason_en: Compromised Flatpak repositories can exploit extract_extra_data() to write attacker-controlled content to arbitrary host filesystem locations with root privileges.
items.reason_zh: 被攻陷的Flatpak仓库可调用extract_extra_data()，以root权限将攻击者控制的内容写入任意主机文件系统路径。

items.reason_en: EAP's JDKBridge honors attacker-supplied CDR codebase URLs during object unmarshalling, permitting unauthenticated remote class loading before security interceptors execute.
items.reason_zh: EAP的JDKBridge在对象反序列化过程中接受攻击者提供的CDR codebase URL，允许在安全拦截器执行前进行未经身份验证的远程类加载。

items.reason_en: Command injection in Visual Studio Code allows local code execution during development, posing significant risks to developer workstations and source code confidentiality.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code中的命令注入漏洞可在开发期间实现本地代码执行，对开发者工作站及源代码机密性构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: Code injection capabilities in Visual Studio Code allow remote attackers to bypass security sandboxing and execute code in developer workstations.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code中的代码注入能力使远程攻击者能够绕过安全沙箱并在开发者工作站上执行代码。

items.reason_en: Logging sensitive data in Aspire applications creates information disclosure risks that violate privacy standards and aid threat reconnaissance.
items.reason_zh: Aspire应用程序记录敏感数据会产生信息泄露风险，不仅违反隐私标准，还会助长威胁侦察活动。

items.reason_en: Developer toolchain compromise risks supply chain attacks, as heap corruption enables remote code execution during software development workflows.
items.reason_zh: 开发者工具链遭攻陷会引发供应链攻击风险，因为堆内存损坏可在软件开发流程中导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: IDE exposure can leak sensitive project data and credentials due to insufficient access controls in Visual Studio Code.
items.reason_zh: 由于Visual Studio Code访问控制不足，IDE暴露可能导致敏感项目数据和凭据泄露。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated network RCE in Visual Studio Code via untrusted search path affects widespread developer environments and build systems.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code中通过不受信任搜索路径实现的未认证网络远程代码执行漏洞，影响了广泛的开发者环境及构建系统。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Microsoft Office PowerPoint allows remote code execution via malicious presentations, serving as a common phishing attack vector.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office PowerPoint中的释放后使用漏洞允许通过恶意演示文稿实现远程代码执行，是常见的网络钓鱼攻击向量。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Microsoft Office Word enables remote code execution through crafted documents, frequently targeted in social engineering campaigns.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Word中的释放后使用漏洞可通过构造的文档实现远程代码执行，在社会工程学攻击活动中常被利用。

items.reason_en: TOCTOU race condition in Erlang/OTP SSL DTLS module allows unauthenticated denial of service by crashing active sessions. Affects backend services relying on Erlang for secure communications.
items.reason_zh: Erlang/OTP SSL DTLS模块中的TOCTOU竞争条件漏洞允许攻击者通过崩溃活跃会话实施未认证的拒绝服务攻击。影响依赖Erlang进行安全通信的后端服务。

items.reason_en: Improper path validation in the Gleam compiler allows arbitrary filesystem modification during dependency downloads. This build pipeline vulnerability can introduce malicious code during compilation.
items.reason_zh: Gleam编译器中的路径验证不当漏洞允许在下载依赖项时修改任意文件系统内容。此构建流水线漏洞可能在编译阶段引入恶意代码。

items.reason_en: Download of code without integrity checks in N-able N-central enables remote code inclusion. As an MSP/RMM platform, this flaw could allow attackers to compromise managed endpoints at scale.
items.reason_zh: N-able N-central在未进行完整性校验的情况下下载代码，可实现远程代码包含。作为MSP/RMM平台，该缺陷可能使攻击者大规模攻陷受管终端。

items.reason_en: Command injection via unsanitized SCSI name strings in sg3_utils allows attackers to inject arbitrary properties into udev rules, compromising system storage management.
items.reason_zh: sg3_utils中未清理的SCSI名称字符串可导致命令注入，使攻击者能够将任意属性注入udev规则，破坏系统存储管理。

items.reason_en: Unbounded busy loop in gnome-remote-desktop TLS handlers enables remote denial of service by exhausting connection-throttling slots without completing handshakes.
items.reason_zh: gnome-remote-desktop TLS处理程序中的无界忙等待循环可在未完成握手的情况下耗尽连接限流槽位，从而实现远程拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Resource exhaustion vulnerability in BlueprintUE Self-Hosted Edition allows attackers to fill server storage by repeatedly creating anonymous blueprints with infinite expiration.
items.reason_zh: BlueprintUE Self-Hosted Edition中的资源耗尽漏洞允许攻击者通过反复创建具有无限过期时间的匿名蓝图来占满服务器存储空间。

items.reason_en: Misconfigured CORS policy in RESTEasy reflects Origin headers alongside credentials, facilitating cross-origin credential theft by malicious websites.
items.reason_zh: RESTEasy中配置错误的CORS策略会将Origin头与凭据一同返回，助长恶意网站进行跨域凭据窃取。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization checks in FlockOS visual alerts allow cross-organization data manipulation, highlighting SaaS multi-tenant isolation weaknesses.
items.reason_zh: FlockOS可视化警报中缺失的授权检查允许跨组织数据篡改，凸显了SaaS多租户隔离机制的弱点。

items.reason_en: Insufficient validation in SAP ABAP Developer Tools permits high-privileged users to submit crafted inputs for arbitrary code execution, impacting internal development workflows.
items.reason_zh: SAP ABAP Developer Tools中验证不足的问题允许高权限用户提交构造的输入以执行任意代码，影响内部开发流程。

items.reason_en: Build script execution flaw in ESEngine causes permission issues during compilation, disrupting CI/CD pipeline integrity.
items.reason_zh: ESEngine中的构建脚本执行缺陷会导致编译过程中的权限问题，破坏CI/CD流水线的完整性。

items.reason_en: Heap out-of-bounds write in node-fontnik can be triggered by malicious fonts, posing a risk to application stability and memory safety.
items.reason_zh: node-fontnik中的堆越界写入漏洞可通过恶意字体触发，威胁应用程序的稳定性与内存安全。
